brief: Service business to AI product business. The 90-day pivot, the revenue dip, the unlock on the other side.

slots.title: Stop doing
slots.description: Service businesses hit a ceiling. This is the 90-day playbook to productize with AI and escape the hourly trap.
slots.goodLabel1: AI products scale around the clock

slots.title: Kill the hourly
slots.description: Service businesses sell time. Product businesses sell outcomes. Switching your pricing is the first domino in the pivot.
slots.badText: Every project priced by the hour with scope creep destroying margins.
slots.goodText: Fixed subscription pricing delivers predictable MRR without extra hours.

slots.title: Automate the
slots.description: Manual delivery is your bottleneck. AI agents handle onboarding, fulfillment, and support while you sleep.
slots.badText: You personally deliver every asset, revision, and report by hand.
slots.goodText: AI runs onboarding, builds deliverables, and handles support tickets instantly.

slots.title: Replace referrals
slots.description: Waiting for word-of-mouth keeps you small. A content engine generates leads while you build the product.
slots.badText: New clients come only from networking events and slow referrals.
slots.goodText: SEO and LinkedIn content bring qualified buyers on autopilot daily.

slots.title: Stop hiring
slots.description: More clients used to mean more hires. Now AI agents scale your output without adding headcount.
slots.badText: Each new client required another contractor or employee to fulfill.
slots.goodText: One operator and AI agents handle fifty clients without breaking a sweat.

slots.title: Survive the
slots.description: Pivoting means saying no to service income temporarily. The dip is real, but so is the recovery.
slots.badText: Comfortable service revenue masks the fact that you own nothing scalable.
slots.goodText: Sixty days of lower revenue explodes into product growth you cannot outwork.

slots.title: Unlock infinite
slots.description: Service revenue is capped by your hours. Product revenue breaks the ceiling and compounds while you sleep.
slots.badText: You are the product, which means growth stops when you run out of time.
slots.goodText: AI products sell, deliver, and support thousands of users without your input.

slots.body: Join 500+ founders who made the 90-day pivot. The unlock starts with one decision.
